\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{positioning}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=2cm]
  \node[draw, rectangle] (a) {Input};
  \node[draw, rectangle, right of=a] (b) {Process};
  \node[draw, rectangle, right of=b] (c) {Output};
  \draw[->] (a) -- (b);
  \draw[->] (b) -- (c);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
